no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Dyadic is a protein-production platform company (C1 and Dapibus platforms) targeting life sciences, food and nutrition, and bio-industrial markets — not a drug developer. The only clinical-stage candidate, DYAI-100 (C1-produced SARS-CoV-2 vaccine), completed a Phase 1 study and further development is explicitly paused per the FY2025 10-K. All other programs (RSV, H5 trimeric antigen, etc.) are preclinical and partner/grant-funded.
